definitions.explanation: Physical movement or motion of a person, animal, or thing.
Changes, developments, or activity in a situation — such as market trends, political movements, or social changes. Used to describe shifts and emerging patterns.

examples.japanese: {敵|てき}の{動|うご}きを{見|み}る。
カメラの{動|うご}きが{滑|なめ}らかだ。
{猫|ねこ}の{素早|すばや}い{動|うご}きに{驚|おどろ}いた。
examples.english: I was surprised by the cat's quick movements.

examples.japanese: {市場|しじょう}の{動|うご}きに{注目|ちゅうもく}する。
examples.english: I keep an eye on market trends.

examples.japanese: {政界|せいかい}に{新|あたら}しい{動|うご}きが{出|で}てきた。
examples.english: New developments have emerged in the political world.

examples.japanese: {最近|さいきん}、{環境|かんきょう}{問題|もんだい}に{対|たい}する{市民|しみん}の{動|うご}きが{活発|かっぱつ}になっている。
examples.english: Recently, citizen activity regarding environmental issues has been intensifying.

notes:
{動|うご}き is the noun form of {動|うご}く (to move). It covers both physical motion and abstract developments or trends.

SENSE 1 - PHYSICAL MOVEMENT:
- {体|からだ}の{動|うご}き: body movement
- {素早|すばや}い{動|うご}き: swift movement

SENSE 2 - DEVELOPMENTS/TRENDS:
- {市場|しじょう}の{動|うご}き: market movements
- {政治|せいじ}の{動|うご}き: political developments
- {最新|さいしん}の{動|うご}き: latest developments

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {動|うご}きを{見|み}せる: to show signs of activity
- {動|うご}きが{出|で}る: developments emerge
- {動|うご}きを{追|お}う: to follow/track movements
- {動|うご}きが{活発|かっぱつ}になる: activity intensifies
- {動|うご}きが{取|と}れない: cannot move
